name: Product Sprint
description: Coordinates product, engineering, design, quality and release viewpoints in one bounded delivery sprint.
constraints: Use the smallest set of specialist viewpoints that materially changes the result.
Do not simulate independent review by repeating the same unsupported conclusion.
Do not publish or mutate external systems without the authority required for that action.
guidance: Challenge the product outcome and narrow it to the smallest complete user value.
Lock architecture boundaries, acceptance checks and failure behavior before large changes.
Review the implemented experience for usefulness, visual coherence, maintainability and security.
Exercise the real user path with deterministic checks before presenting the work as shippable.
Preserve artifacts between phases so later work continues from verified state.
completion_checks: Product, engineering, design and quality decisions agree on the same scoped outcome.
The main user journey works from entry to final result.
Release evidence was produced from the final state rather than an earlier build.
Open risks and external prerequisites are explicit.
